scope: SEPARATE real physical light-tunnel learned latent sensory state vs conventional recurrent controls; source-observational DEVELOPER evidence ONLY.
motivation: WSP186 gave a preregistered negative on public wind-tunnel measurements: gated scalar residual corrections underperformed trained ARX. No reruns/retuning. A different physical light-tunnel source, new actual records and learned two-dimensional causal-candidate sensory state are now tested; calling it causal identification is prohibited.

original_data_roster.FIT_and_VALID: actuators_white.csv: first 7,000 chronological rows (indices 0..6999) FIT, last 3,000 (indices 7000..9999) VALID, exactly 10,000 source rows
original_data_roster.PUBLIC_DEV_1: color_mix.csv: 10,000 physically recorded measurements in chronological order (no training, no post-decision tuning)
original_data_roster.PUBLIC_DEV_2: smooth_polarizers.csv: 10,000 separately physically recorded measurements, new polarizer/variance and input distribution; no post-decision tuning
original_data_roster.source_preflight: all three exact source members, observed hashes, presence of seven public controlled actuator names and three target sensor columns; no extra/downsampled/altered records; abort on missing/short/invalid, do not silently repair
original_data_roster.sensor_caveat: light tunnel is ONE physical chamber with a constant base configuration; separately generated excitation processes are NOT novel source-born mechanisms or true independent law transfer.

learned_problem.features: FIT-only z-scored seven public actuators, intercept, and deterministic fixed sin/cos(2 angle) features for two polarizers; no source ID/flag/timestamp/future target
learned_problem.state: FIT-only batch-ridge baseline predicts three normalized sensors; learn a 2-dimensional principal residual subspace from FIT-only sensor innovations via deterministic symmetric covariance deflation/power iteration, then a fitted recurrent readout from previous public residual state to present normalized sensor residual.
learned_problem.candidate: learned frozen two-state projection and readout plus a bounded local patch of its readout, updated only after 3 consecutive public prediction innovations >2.0 FIT innovation sigma; learning rate 0.05, patch abs <=0.5 per element, decay 0.995 otherwise. The sensor outcome at t may update memory only AFTER all t predictions scored.
controls: FIT-only fully trained batch ridge on identical current features
FIT-only fully fitted 3-target autoregression using current features and 3 already observed previous target values
FIT-only fully fitted 3x3 previous-residual linear recurrence using exactly same FIT examples
FIT-only frozen 2D learned residual projection/readout with no online patch
FIT-only batch ridge + alpha 0.1 conventional EMA of previous prediction error
learned_problem.strongest_control: For diagnostics report per-output *best achieved scored control* after each public DEV (conservative oracle lower-bound, never treat it as available to production selector). Select operational conventional comparator from VALID only, never from public DEV.
learned_problem.frozen_win: On BOTH separately physically recorded public DEV excitation regimes, learned adaptive state beats strongest held scored conventional control on all THREE sensors by >=5% relative normalized RMSE, with byte-identical archived pretrained core. Else DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; report full negative table, no post-public tuning.
learned_problem.cold_retention: SHA256 checkpoint of pretrained core and state basis before/after public DEV must be byte-identical. This verifies software immutability ONLY, not cold behavioral transfer to old source or episodic learning.
learned_problem.pass1: parser/source admission and FIT-only state/baseline qualification
learned_problem.pass2: single source-private numeric score on VALID then public DEV, with no more tuning if non-positive or source invalid.
learned_problem.strong_negative: If learned low-rank state is just an algebraically compressed conventional residual predictor or full recurrence matches or wins, do not claim cognitive or causal novelty, only a verified learned representation capability.
